definitions: A member of an ancient people who inhabited parts of northern and eastern Scotland from at least the late Iron Age until the 10th century.
The language of the Picts, of uncertain affiliation, known only from place names and a few inscriptions.
examples: The Picts were known for their distinctive stone carvings.
Archaeologists have uncovered several Pictish settlements.
The Pict language is largely undeciphered.
